text:
Noah (CSM): Alerting team 3 EpochAI DAU for /generate collapsed ~60% WoW, active seats 58 -> 20. Renewal ~8w. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/metrics/epochai. Need quick triage and plan; they mentioned a short RFP with a competitor last week.

Zara (CS Ops): I pulled metrics  generation calls down, embeddings steady. p95 latency up 900ms -> 1.8s over last 9d. No 5xx spikes. SDK telemetry shows an uptick in `retries` from their client.

Luke (AE): Champion (Amin) left two weeks ago. New buyer is a PM, Sara, who hasn't scheduled calls. Procurement finance emailed asking for cost breakdown yesterday.

Ivy (Product): We kicked a low-cost token-budget variant 12 days ago that applies stricter `max_tokens` and early-stop heuristics on `low-priority` routes. That could cause truncated replies if routed. I'll check routing map for account `epochai-prod`.

Rex (Support): Opened ticket E-9052 and requested sample prompts/UX clips. Sara replied that they'd temporarily capped concurrency and lowered batch sizes to save money. She attached an example payload: 

```
{"model":"rw-gen-1.3","prompt":"Summarize the research note...","max_tokens":100,"batch_size":1}
```

Rex (Support): She also noted responses sometimes end mid-sentence. I asked for a few more samples.

Noah (CSM): Given champion churn + competitor POC + procurement pressure, we should prioritize stabilization. Would a 30-day discounted Dedicated pilot (throughput credits + SLA) make sense pre-renewal? Legal quick-SOW possible?

Luke (AE): Yes, propose pilot + exec intro. We need to show probative improvement (full-output rate, p95 reduction) quickly. I can do intro if we have a short playbook.

Zara (CS Ops): Immediate hypotheses: 1) Customer-side concurrency cap reduced apparent DAU; 2) Routed to token-budget variant causing truncation; 3) Client SDK/backoff changes increasing retries and perceived latency. No single 5xx root.

Ivy (Product): Action: I'll confirm routing assignment by 12:00 PT tomorrow and prepare a revert/A-B plan (10% traffic to prior variant) if customer allows. Revert test should show change in `complete` vs `truncated` rates within an hour.

Rex (Support): I'll collect 5 representative payloads and repro steps. Also will try to reproduce truncation in our sandbox with their sample payloads and SDK version.

Noah (CSM): Can someone tag legal/finance? We might need a fast one-off credit. Also we should prepare a short ROI note: estimate value of stability vs switching cost.

HealthBot: Scheduled healthcheck: EpochAI routing + truncation trace  results to E-9052. ETA ~25m.

Luke (AE): I'll draft the customer note/offering and ask for an intro call. Proposal outline: 30-day Dedicated trial (discounted), temporary bump in routing to prior variant for testing, and a joint validation session.

Zara (CS Ops): SDK check: their app reported `client_version: 2.1.0`. v2.1 has a backoff change that can amplify retry storms if concurrency is lowered client-side. I'll validate logs and see if retries correlate with p95 spikes.

Ivy (Product): If Sara permits transient bump, I'll run A/B revert tomorrow 9am PT and instrument metrics: full-output %, p95, tokens per call.

Rex (Support): Owners: Rex collects samples + sandbox repro (ETA 3pm); Zara validates telemetry & concurrency correlation (ETA 2pm); Ivy confirms routing + revert plan (ETA tomorrow 9am PT); Luke leads exec outreach + pilot offer (ETA EOD); Noah drafts procurement ROI note (ETA tomorrow noon).

Noah (CSM): Sounds good. If revert proves truncation is variant-driven and customer agrees to pilot, we expedite legal SOW for quick trial. Tagging @here for visibility. Any objections?

Luke (AE): None. I'll ping Sara for a 20-min sync and attach the stabilization offer.

Ivy (Product): I'll post routing confirmation here once done.

Rex (Support): Posting initial sandbox attempt in E-9052 now.

Noah (CSM): Thanks team  keep updates short in-thread. :thumbsup:
